label: iPad (10th gen) tablet
description: Apple iPad (10th generation) — 10.9-inch tablet, Wi-Fi 6 and 5G sub-6 GHz on cellular models; USB-C port supports USB-C to Ethernet adapters.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz) — no 6 GHz. Cellular (optional SKU): 5G sub-6 GHz only, no mmWave; LTE fallback. USB-C is USB 2.0 but iPadOS supports USB-C Ethernet adapters as a real interface (usb0), which makes this the cheapest 'tablet on a dock' endpoint. Wi-Fi-only SKUs should be modelled without wwan0.
